# Northwind Telecom — Privacy and data retention

*Synthetic document. Northwind Telecom is a fictional operator invented for testing; every figure
below is made up and describes no real product, tariff or person.*

## What is collected

Identity and address documents collected at sign-up; the records a network must keep to place a call
or carry a session, which are the numbers involved, the time, the duration and the cell or node
used; billing and payment records; and the contents of support conversations.

## What is not collected

The content of calls and messages is not recorded. The contents of data sessions are not inspected.
Location is known only to the accuracy of the serving cell and only while the connection is
attached to the network.

## How long it is kept

| Record | Retention |
|---|---|
| Identity and address documents | for the life of the connection plus 1 year |
| Call and session records | 24 months |
| Bills and payment records | 8 years |
| Support conversations | 18 months |
| Marketing preferences | until changed |

Records are deleted within 30 days of the retention period ending.

## Marketing consent

Marketing contact happens only where consent has been given, and consent can be withdrawn at any
time from the app, by replying STOP to any message, or by telling an agent. Withdrawal takes effect
within 24 hours and does not affect service messages, which are sent regardless because they are
needed to operate the connection.

## Sharing

Records are shared with a payment processor to take a payment, with a delivery partner to deliver a
SIM, and with a lawful authority when a written order requires it. They are not sold, and they are
not shared for another company's marketing.

## Your requests

A copy of the records held about you, a correction to them, or their deletion where retention does
not require otherwise, can be requested from the app. A request is answered within 30 days.
